question: Who alone becomes a true performer of the tattva-circle?
premises: A certain arising occurs in some persons
The goddess is addressed as witness
Only those persons are true performers
inference: Only those in whom this arises are tattva-circle performers
uncertainties: What specifically arises (utpadyate) is not explicitly stated in this verse
plain_english: O Goddess, those in whom it arises, they alone are the performers of the tattva-circle.
